name: Treg
summary: Pay-per-call MCP catalog of 4,100+ marketing and enrichment APIs for coding agents.
description: Treg is an OpenRouter-style registry for agent tools: one key unlocks 4,100+ endpoints across 100+ providers (people enrichment, SEO, ads, social, scraping) billed per call at provider rates with 0% markup. Connect via MCP from Claude Code, Codex and similar agents. Differentiator is avoiding monthly data-tool seats for occasional agent runs. $1 free credit to start; bring-your-own-provider-key supported.
features: One key for enrichment, SEO, ads, social and scraping APIs
Pay per call at provider rates, 0% markup
MCP connection for Claude Code, Codex and similar
